properties.name: Examined on the day it was written, so the ledger says "checked" rather than "nobody has ever looked": the file on disk is the file the design registered, the three mirrors are byte-identical (skill_lint), and every tool it names is served (skill_lint's reference check). What that does NOT establish, and the confirmation ledger should not be read as claiming, is that the PROCEDURE works — worktree, claim, export-before-commit, driver merge, release across two people and two checkouts. That needs a field trial, which is where the standing validation disposition puts it.
